verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only that users can try the product via free allowance/Forge to run their own proof-of-concept (datalab-docs-9, datalab-docs-10, datalab-docs-23, datalab-docs-42), but there is no evidence of vendor-published reproducible accuracy benchmarks (e.g., against ground-truth datasets, competitor comparisons, or accuracy metrics). A community comment even flags difficulty in groundtruthing Datalab's OCR output (datalab-comm-1), reinforcing the absence of published benchmark data.
